items.title: Why Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Shares Are Getting Obliterated Today
items.summary: Shares of enterprise technology company Hewlett Packard Enterprise (NYSE:HPE) fell 6% in the morning session after the company reported its quarterly results and an updated full-year outlook that failed to satisfy lofty market expectations. According to a company press release, Hewlett Packard Enterprise generated revenue of $12.21 billion, up 33.7% year on year, and non-GAAP earnings of $1.11 per share.
